title: The set attached to a node of the SEM forcing is transitive
source_title: Conservation of Ramsey's theorem for pairs and well-foundedness

standard_prerequisites.name: Conditions of the SEM forcing and the sets X_a and A_i(R)
standard_prerequisites.statement: In the SEM section the requirements to be satisfied are listed by the author at source lines 810-815, and a condition is a pair (sigma, a) built from a finite set and an infinite set X_a; the sets A_i(R) for i below two are the two sides of the partition induced by the stable colouring R on X_a.
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the objects of the counted lemma, namely a condition (sigma, a) and one of its nodes, and the colouring R with respect to which transitivity is asserted.

standard_prerequisites.name: Node of a condition and the set pi of a node
standard_prerequisites.statement: A (sigma, a)-node is an M-finite sequence of pairs (i_s, rho_s) where each i_s is below two and each rho_s is a non-empty M-finite R-transitive subset of X_a whose minimum exceeds the maximum of the previous one, with the comparability pattern between consecutive blocks determined by the bits i_s; pi of the node is the union of sigma with all the blocks; the author's own definition is retained at source lines 819-829.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma asserts that this union is R-transitive, so the object pi and the constraints on the blocks must be available.

standard_prerequisites.name: Minimal interval of a transitive set and Sigma^0_0 induction
standard_prerequisites.statement: For an R-transitive set, the minimal intervals are the maximal blocks of consecutive elements; Sigma^0_0 induction is available in the models considered, which is what permits the author's rank-by-rank argument.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof proceeds by Sigma^0_0 induction on the rank of the block and shows that each new block lies inside a minimal interval of the union built so far.

core_obligations: Write the node as the sequence of pairs (i_0, rho_0) up to (i_{q-1}, rho_{q-1}) and set up a Sigma^0_0 induction on the rank (source lines 835-836).

State the induction invariant: for every rank below t, the block at that rank is an R-transitive tournament contained in a minimal interval of the union of sigma with all earlier blocks, and the union of sigma with all blocks up to that rank is R-transitive (source line 836).
Verify the base case: the invariant holds at rank zero because (sigma, a) is a condition (source line 838).

Perform the induction step: the construction of the next block puts it inside a minimal interval and makes it comparable with every earlier block in the direction prescribed by the corresponding bit, so no element of the earlier union lies between two elements of the new block (source line 838).

Conclude that, since the earlier union is R-transitive by the induction hypothesis and the new block is an R-transitive tournament lying inside one of its minimal intervals, the enlarged union is R-transitive as well, which at the last rank is the statement of the counted lemma (source lines 838-839).

proof_roadmap.step: Expand the node and set up the Sigma^0_0 induction with its invariant.
Base case from the condition, then the step using the minimal interval and the prescribed comparability.
Conclude transitivity of the full union.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Lemma lem:sem-wf-nodes-transitive（源 831-833 行，证明 834-839 行）：SEM 力迫中任一条件 (σ,a) 的任一节点 ν，其并集 π(ν) 都是 R-传递的。关键操作不是例行核验：必须用 Σ^0_0 归纳逐块论证，并在归纳假设里同时维持两条性质——「新块落在已建并集的某个极小区间内」与「已建并集自身 R-传递」（836 行）；归纳步要同时用到节点定义中「ρ_s 的最小元大于前一块的最大元」与「按 i_s 规定的可比较方向」，才能断言旧并集中没有元素夹在新块的两个元素之间（838 行），进而由「传递竞赛图落在极小区间内」推出扩并集仍传递。难点在于两条不变量互相支撑、缺一不可；原文位置在证明的 836 行与 838 行。
